mapper.sql: select user_id, expire_time, update_by, update_time from vip_membership
mapper.insert: insert into vip_membership (user_id, expire_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{expireTime}, #{updateBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select m.user_id, m.expire_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, u.user_name, u.nick_name from sys_user u left join vip_membership m on m.user_id = u.user_id where u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id = #{userId} and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') order by m.expire_time is null, m.expire_time desc, u.user_id
